name: golden-trophy-r1-goblins
description: Quest for the Golden Trophy room 1: walk from the room-1 spawn to the goblins around (43,-0.8,30) and fight them with SM64 punches, then punch-punch-kick, aiming inside the SM64 +-60 deg attack cone from live enemy positions.
notes: Room-1 spawn (53.38,-0.74,29.29) from gt-r1-v3-death.log. Enemy positions come from the read-only nearest-enemy query on the combat runtime's original Enemy list (IsAlive, transform position), never from authored data.
Native SM64 input only. Launch: -Quest golden-trophy -QuestStart -QuestRoom 1 -MarioFollow -MarioCombat (-MarioQaImmortal for unattended QA).
